instruction: Find the last name in Cell C15 of the LibreOffice Calc file and perform a Google search for it using Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Task asks to copy cell C15 (Last Name column, row 15) from the spreadsheet and search it in Chrome. Verified from Excel file: Row 15, Column C contains 'Hazelton'. Evaluator checks if active tab URL matches Google search for 'hazelton'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if correct Google search performed, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_tab_info' correctly extracts active Chrome tab URL from accessibility tree and retrieves full page info
Metric 'is_expected_search_query' correctly uses regex pattern matching on the active tab URL
Expected regex pattern '(?i)https?://(?:www\.)?google\.com/search\?q=hazelton(?:&|$|#).*' correctly matches Google search for 'hazelton' (case-insensitive, flexible parameters)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts URL dict -> metric checks URL field against pattern
Expected value 'Hazelton' is verified as correct last name in cell C15 per metadata
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the Google search was performed (the verifiable end state of the instruction)
No postconfig needed: verification targets Chrome active tab state which remains accessible after search
Practical feasibility confirmed: getter can extract URL from accessibility tree and navigate to it, metric can match regex pattern
